description:
Join our innovative team at Mastex Software as a Middle & Senior .NET & Angular Developer! We are a passionate, dynamic company that has been at the forefront of maritime software solutions since 2006. Our flagship product, MX Suite, is designed to tackle the complexities of maritime fleet management and our new product, TeamTide, addresses the intricate world of crew management, and we are looking for talented developers to help us push the boundaries of technology in this field.


Why Mastex Software?

  • Collaborative Culture: Be part of a small, dedicated team where your ideas matter. We value creativity and encourage open discussions about software development.
  • Impactful Work: Help shipping companies and managers solve real-world challenges with our cutting-edge solutions.
  • Growth Opportunities: Engage with new technologies and standards that will shape the future of maritime software.


What We’re Looking For

We seek developers who are:

  • Team Players: Able to work independently as well as collaboratively.
  • Results-Oriented: Committed to meeting deadlines while delivering high-quality work.
  • Positive Thinkers: Bring a sense of humour and a constructive attitude to the team.


Technical Requirements

To succeed in this role, you should have:

  • Experience: At least 3 years in C# development.
  • Framework Proficiency: Strong knowledge of Angular and Web API.
  • Database Skills: Good understanding of SQL Server and database design.
  • Design Patterns: Familiarity with software design patterns.
  • Client-Side Technologies: Experience with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and TypeScript.


What We Offer:

  • Flexible Work Environment: Enjoy the option to work remotely from Romania or work in our office in Piata Unirii, Bucharest.
  • Competitive Salary Package: Attractive compensation tailored to your experience.
  • Generous Leave Policy: 24 vacation days per year.
  • Professional Development: Access to PluralSight subscriptions and Microsoft Certifications.
  • Health Benefits: Private medical subscription included.
  • Team Events: Participate in team-building activities that you can propose.


If you’re enthusiastic about software development and ready to make an impact in the maritime industry, we want to hear from you! Apply now and be part of our journey at Mastex Software.

You can find out more about us at mastexsoftware.com
